trump.title: Judge Ana C. Reyes, who was appointed by Crooked Joe Biden, and is handling the East Potomac Golf Course, referred to as Trash Island because it has been in such bad shape for so many years, is doing everything in her power to stop the Department of the Interior from bringing an old, decrepit, and very unsafe Golf Course from being built into a Course that Washington and, indeed, the U.S.A., can be proud of. The new Course will be open to the Public, and for residents of Washington, D.C., at a substantially reduced rate. It will also be a Course designed to the Highest Standards of Golf. The Department of the Interior has an absolute right to renovate the Course, but the judge is not allowing them to do so, at great danger and peril to the Public. She wants to become a Golf Course Designer and approve every move we make — And it just doesn’t work that way. This Project can be done easily and quickly. We are simply replacing a dangerous and bad Golf Course with a safe and good Golf Course, one that will be GREAT for the area. Time is of the essence — This is a Project that must be started, IMMEDIATELY, or many Seasons will be missed, and the costs will only continue to rise! Thank you for your attention to this matter. President DONALD J. TRUMP

I am pleased to nominate Jim O’Neill to serve as Judge on the United States District Court for the Middle District of North Carolina. Jim has the strong support of both North Carolina Senators, Ted Budd and Thom Tillis. Jim has served as the District Attorney of Forsyth County since 2009, and has been a prosecutor in that office since 1997. He has a deep track record of being tough on crime, and preserving Law and Order. Jim is a graduate of Duke University (where he played varsity lacrosse), and New York Law School. The people of North Carolina are lucky to have a dedicated public servant like Jim who will be a fantastic Judge. Congratulations Jim. Now, let’s get him confirmed! President DONALD J. TRUMP

I want to thank Uzbekistan's Highly Respected President, Shavkat Mirziyoyev, for the beautiful Uzbek Gazebos (or “Aywans”) gifted to me in honor of our Country’s 250 years of Independence. It was my Honor to do a flyover in Marine One during last week’s Gazebo Ceremony featuring Uzbek Ambassador Furqat Sidikov and Interior Secretary Doug Burgum — and the Gazebos look STUNNING!Uzbek master craftsmen left their families in Uzbekistan for several months, and skillfully built these Gazebos out of 200-year-old mountain walnut trees, in tough weather conditions. They had real talent!Rather than keep this gift as “private,” I wanted to donate these beautiful Gazebos to the Public, right next to the Tidal Basin, with views of the Jefferson Memorial and Washington Monument, in our now Safe and Beautiful Capital.A year from now, when the National Garden of Heroes opens, these Gazebos will be one of the “hottest” places in town for marriage proposals, diplomatic receptions, photoshoots during the Cherry Blossom Festival, and every day visits to the Tidal Basin.I also want to thank the Uzbek Embassy in Washington and the National Park Service, who worked closely alongside the Great Uzbek Craftsmen. We are making D.C. More Beautiful than Ever Before! President DONALD J. TRUMP

I am proud to announce that the FIFA Women's World Cup 2031 will take place in the United States! After hosting the Most Successful World Cup in History, no Country is better positioned than the United States to be home to the largest Women's Sporting Event in History. The FIFA Women's World Cup 2031 will bring Generational Economic Impact to the United States, grow the sport of Soccer throughout our Country and the World, and showcase America’s Exceptionalism. Thank you to Gianni Infantino, and his great staff, for working to bring the Tournament to the U.S.A. President DONALD J. TRUMP

EXTREME CLIMATE SCIENCE “BITES THE DUST!”Climate Change activists always described their Extreme Climate Science assumptions as “settled science,” and the scenarios of doom and destruction based on “Climate Change” have dominated their outlook. Well, their Climate Science has now been debunked, withdrawn, and taken down by the UN IPCC. That’s right, the same organization that published these projections as “settled science” has now determined they are not reliable and have withdrawn them. No more catastrophic predictions. GONE! GONE! GONE! Thank you for your attention to this matter. President DONALD J. TRUMP

Iowa is a very special place to me, a place that I won, by substantial margins, in all three Elections but, whether I won or lost, would never deter me from making a correct decision. As everyone knows, there is a Military “clean up” operation, without which, a very dangerous situation exists. In 2009, the Obama Administration improperly stored a vast number of explosives, and the Experts, who know it well, and have been studying it for many years, feel there is a substantial chance that this material will explode of its own volition, perhaps sometime in the near future. We have an opportunity to do a highly controlled detonation of these dangerous and rapidly corroding materials. The Experts, in particular the United States Military, feel that this approach will be a far safer one than allowing the situation to fester, not knowing when they will detonate by themselves. This operation would, in other words, be a controlled one rather than a large, spontaneous explosion. The weather, right now, is optimal for this planned response to take place. I feel the proper course is to get rid of this longterm problem but, at the same time, have ordered the Military not to do so until such time as the Eighth Circuit agrees that we can go forward, and am further making this decision fully subject to the incoming Governor Elect, Rob Sand, agreeing to the operation. If he or the Courts do not agree, we will have no choice but to not proceed with the controlled removal of these hazardous materials, and be forced to hold the incoming Governor responsible for any and all death or destruction caused by this very unfortunate, and longterm, situation. Thank you for your attention to this matter! President DONALD J. TRUMP
Congratulations to NVIDIA on having made, what I consider to be, an absolutely GREAT decision! President DONALD J. TRUMP

The NVIDIA Board of Directors has made the correct and proper decision to return Jensen Huang to the position of CEO. The Country needs Jensen’s leadership at NVIDIA in order to ensure the Success and Prosperity of not only the Company, but the American Economy. The United States Government has no reason to believe that Jensen’s return to NVIDIA poses any risk to National Security. The Attorney General of the United States has confirmed that the U.S. Government does not possess evidence that he has engaged in any unlawful conduct. On a personal note, I have gotten to know Jensen, and he is a Great Patriot and National Treasure. Separately, NVIDIA should continue its thorough internal investigation of the Company’s compliance with U.S. export controls in order to ensure that it is fulfilling its legal obligations and Patriotic Duty to protect U.S. National Security. Congratulations to Jensen, the NVIDIA Board, to the People of the United States — and, indeed, the World! Thank you for your attention to this matter. President DONALD J. TRUMP
